{{Quote|My name is Sunif Brecanti. I'm the broker for a webberie co-op in the Beldoni Valley. The estates I represent, some have been in business almost a millennium|Sunif Brecanti to a town hall on Ghorman|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />}} 
'''Sunif Brecanti''' was a [[gender|male]] [[human]] with light skin. During the [[Imperial Era]], they worked as the broker for a co-op of nine [[webberie]]s in the [[Beldoni Valley]] on [[Ghorman]]. In [[3 BBY]], Brecanti addressed a [[Palmo Town Hall|town hall]] in [[Palmo]], In the address they stated that all of their clients were considering not opening their hives the following spring due to [[Galactic Empire]]'s ground inspections, freight penalties, and shipping codes changing without warning. They told their electors at the hall the Empire was killing them and that the electors were letting it happen.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />

==Personality and traits==
During the meeting, Brecanti had [[color|greying]] [[hair]] and wore a maroon [[clothing|suit]] over a white shirt. He expressed his disappointment to Carro Rylanz and other Ghorman electors for letting the Imperial occupation on Ghorman and was very concerned on his trading business.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sunif Brecanti was created for the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the season's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[Philippe Spall]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />
